CREATE TABLE account_emails (
	account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	verified_email VARCHAR(320), 
	verified_at DATETIME, 
	pending_email VARCHAR(320), 
	pending_requested_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (account_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_email_verified_state CHECK ((verified_email IS NULL) = (verified_at IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_email_pending_state CHECK ((pending_email IS NULL) = (pending_requested_at IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES local_accounts (id), 
	UNIQUE (verified_email)
)

CREATE TABLE account_recovery_rate_windows (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	scope_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	window_started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_account_recovery_rate_window UNIQUE (action, scope_digest, window_started_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_recovery_rate_action CHECK (action IN ('EMAIL_CHANGE','EMAIL_RESEND','PASSWORD_RESET')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_recovery_rate_digest CHECK (length(scope_digest) = 64), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_recovery_rate_count CHECK (count >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE account_recovery_tokens (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, 
	token_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	consumed_at DATETIME, 
	invalidated_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_recovery_token_purpose CHECK (purpose IN ('EMAIL_VERIFICATION','PASSWORD_RESET')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_recovery_token_digest CHECK (length(token_digest) = 64), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_recovery_token_expiry CHECK (expires_at > created_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_recovery_token_terminal CHECK (consumed_at IS NULL OR invalidated_at IS NULL), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES local_accounts (id), 
	UNIQUE (token_digest)
)

CREATE TABLE agent_messages (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	author_user_id CHAR(32), 
	content_md TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_messages_id_session UNIQUE (id, session_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_messages_session_sequence UNIQUE (session_id, sequence), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_messages_sequence CHECK (sequence > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_messages_role CHECK (role IN ('USER', 'AGENT', 'SYSTEM')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE agent_run_events (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	cursor INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_run_events_run_cursor UNIQUE (run_id, cursor), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_run_events_run_key UNIQUE (run_id, idempotency_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_events_cursor CHECK (cursor > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_events_kind CHECK (kind IN ('RUN_STARTED', 'ASSISTANT_DELTA', 'ASSISTANT_MESSAGE_COMPLETED', 'USAGE_REPORTED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED', 'RUN_COMPLETED', 'RUN_CANCELLED', 'RUN_FAILED', 'RUN_TIMED_OUT', 'RUNNER_LOST', 'TOOL_REQUESTED', 'TOOL_RESULT')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES agent_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE agent_run_usage (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	event_cursor INTEGER, 
	source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	input_tokens INTEGER, 
	output_tokens INTEGER, 
	total_tokens INTEGER, 
	observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_run_usage_event UNIQUE (run_id, event_cursor), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_agent_run_usage_event FOREIGN KEY(run_id, event_cursor) REFERENCES agent_run_events (run_id, cursor), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_usage_input CHECK (input_tokens IS NULL OR input_tokens >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_usage_output CHECK (output_tokens IS NULL OR output_tokens >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_usage_total CHECK (total_tokens IS NULL OR total_tokens >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_usage_source CHECK (source IN ('PROVIDER_REPORTED', 'ESTIMATED', 'UNKNOWN')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES agent_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE agent_runs (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	session_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	project_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	agent_version_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	requested_by_user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_message_id CHAR(32), 
	client_request_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	parent_run_id CHAR(32), 
	gateway_profile_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	gateway_credential_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	gateway_model_id VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	queue_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	input_message_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	requested_context_revision_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	requested_context_artifact_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lease_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lease_owner VARCHAR(200), 
	lease_acquired_at DATETIME, 
	lease_expires_at DATETIME, 
	cancel_requested_at DATETIME, 
	deadline_at DATETIME, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	finished_at DATETIME, 
	failure_code VARCHAR(64), 
	next_event_cursor INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_runs_id_session UNIQUE (id, session_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_runs_scope UNIQUE (id, project_id, requested_by_user_id, agent_version_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_runs_full_scope UNIQUE (id, session_id, project_id, requested_by_user_id, agent_version_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_runs_request_message UNIQUE (request_message_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_runs_client_request UNIQUE (session_id, client_request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_runs_session_queue UNIQUE (session_id, queue_sequence), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_agent_runs_session_project FOREIGN KEY(session_id, project_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions (id, project_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_agent_runs_request_message_session FOREIGN KEY(request_message_id, session_id) REFERENCES agent_messages (id, session_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_runs_queue_sequence CHECK (queue_sequence > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_runs_input_message_sequence CHECK (input_message_sequence > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_runs_attempt CHECK (attempt >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_runs_lease_generation CHECK (lease_generation >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_runs_event_cursor CHECK (next_event_cursor >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_runs_status CHECK (status IN ('QUEUED', 'CLAIMED', 'RUNNING', 'CANCELLING', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT')),

	FOREIGN KEY(requested_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_run_id) REFERENCES agent_runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(gateway_profile_id) REFERENCES gateway_profiles (id)

CREATE TABLE agent_sessions (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	project_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	agent_version_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_by_user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(300), 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	next_message_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	next_run_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	archived_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_sessions_id_project UNIQUE (id, project_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_sessions_message_sequence CHECK (next_message_sequence >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_sessions_run_sequence CHECK (next_run_sequence >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_agent_sessions_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ARCHIVED')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(agent_version_id) REFERENCES platform_agent_versions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE artifact_research_links (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	revision_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_revision_id CHAR(32), 
	role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	contribution_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_by_user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_artifact_research_role CHECK (role IN ('SOURCE','INPUT','EVIDENCE','OUTPUT','FORMALIZATION','CERTIFICATE')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_artifact_research_binding UNIQUE (artifact_id, revision_id, attempt_revision_id, role), 
	FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(revision_id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_revision_id) REFERENCES research_attempt_revisions (revision_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(contribution_id) REFERENCES contribution_envelopes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE artifacts (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	ownership_scope_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	contribution_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_by_user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	byte_length BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	media_type VARCHAR(127) NOT NULL, 
	storage_key VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	source_revision_id CHAR(32), 
	library_destination_revision_id CHAR(32), 
	environment JSON, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	verified_at DATETIME, 
	committed_at DATETIME, 
	deleted_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_artifacts_id_scope UNIQUE (id, ownership_scope_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_artifacts_sha256_length CHECK (length(sha256) = 64), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_artifacts_byte_length CHECK (byte_length >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_artifacts_state CHECK (state IN ('STAGING','COMMITTED','DELETING','DELETED')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_artifacts_lifecycle CHECK ((state = 'STAGING' AND committed_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'COMMITTED' AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND committed_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'DELETING' AND committed_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'DELETED' AND committed_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(ownership_scope_id) REFERENCES research_scopes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(contribution_id) REFERENCES contribution_envelopes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (storage_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_revision_id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(library_destination_revision_id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE attempt_evidence_links (
	attempt_revision_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_revision_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_revision_id, evidence_revision_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_attempt_evidence_position UNIQUE (attempt_revision_id, position), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_attempt_evidence_position CHECK (position >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_attempt_evidence_role CHECK (role IN ('INPUT', 'SUPPORTS', 'CONTRADICTS', 'OUTPUT')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_revision_id) REFERENCES research_attempt_revisions (revision_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(evidence_revision_id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE auth_sessions (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	token_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	reauthenticated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	password_reauthenticated_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES local_accounts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE catalogue_audit (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	entry_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	revision_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	contribution_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_catalogue_audit_action CHECK (action IN ('ADMIT', 'PROMOTE', 'REVISE', 'HIDE', 'RESTORE')), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_catalogue_audit_revision FOREIGN KEY(revision_id, entry_id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id, object_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(entry_id) REFERENCES catalogue_entries (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(revision_id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id),

)

CREATE TABLE catalogue_entries (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	official_revision_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	admitted_by_user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	hidden BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_catalogue_official_object FOREIGN KEY(official_revision_id, id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id, object_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(id) REFERENCES research_objects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(official_revision_id) REFERENCES statement_revisions (revision_id),

CREATE TABLE catalogue_follows (
	user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	entry_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id, entry_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(entry_id) REFERENCES catalogue_entries (id)
)

CREATE TABLE catalogue_interest (
	user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	entry_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id, entry_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(entry_id) REFERENCES catalogue_entries (id)
)

CREATE TABLE catalogue_moderator_audit (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	operator_user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(operator_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE catalogue_moderators (
	user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE catalogue_revisions (
	revision_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	entry_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_identifier VARCHAR(2000), 
	source_version VARCHAR(500), 
	source_locator VARCHAR(1000), 
	review_rationale TEXT, 
	reviewed_by_user_id CHAR(32), 
	reviewed_at DATETIME, 
	reported_status VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	contribution_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (revision_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_catalogue_source_complete CHECK ((source_identifier IS NOT NULL AND source_version IS NOT NULL AND source_locator IS NOT NULL) OR (source_identifier IS NULL AND source_version IS NULL AND source_locator IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_catalogue_review_complete CHECK ((review_rationale IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (review_rationale IS NULL AND reviewed_by_user_id IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_catalogue_status_basis CHECK (source_identifier IS NOT NULL OR review_rationale IS NOT NULL), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_catalogue_revision_object FOREIGN KEY(revision_id, entry_id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id, object_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(revision_id) REFERENCES statement_revisions (revision_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(entry_id) REFERENCES catalogue_entries (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewed_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(contribution_id) REFERENCES contribution_envelopes (id)
)

CREATE TABLE community_delivery_cursors (
	event_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	entry_id CHAR(32), 
	user_id CHAR(32), 
	done BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES outbox_events (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(entry_id) REFERENCES catalogue_entries (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE context_manifest_artifacts (
	manifest_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (manifest_id, artifact_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_context_manifest_artifact_position CHECK (position >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_context_manifest_artifact_position UNIQUE (manifest_id, position), 
	FOREIGN KEY(manifest_id) REFERENCES context_manifests (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE context_manifests (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	project_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	requested_by_user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	agent_version_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	revision_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	artifact_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_context_manifests_run UNIQUE (run_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_context_manifests_scope UNIQUE (id, run_id, project_id, requested_by_user_id, agent_version_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_context_manifests_run_scope FOREIGN KEY(run_id, project_id, requested_by_user_id, agent_version_id) REFERENCES agent_runs (id, project_id, requested_by_user_id, agent_version_id),

	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(requested_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(agent_version_id) REFERENCES platform_agent_versions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE contribution_entity_links (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	envelope_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	object_id CHAR(32), 
	revision_id CHAR(32), 
	relation_id CHAR(32), 
	comment_id CHAR(32), 
	ownership_scope_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_contribution_output_one_target CHECK ((CASE WHEN object_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN revision_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN relation_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN comment_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 1), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_output_object UNIQUE (envelope_id, object_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_output_revision UNIQUE (envelope_id, revision_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_output_relation UNIQUE (envelope_id, relation_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_output_comment UNIQUE (envelope_id, comment_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(envelope_id) REFERENCES contribution_envelopes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(object_id) REFERENCES research_objects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(revision_id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(relation_id) REFERENCES relation_assertions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(comment_id) REFERENCES research_comments (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(ownership_scope_id) REFERENCES research_scopes (id)
)

CREATE TABLE contribution_envelopes (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	human_user_id CHAR(32), 
	sponsor_user_id CHAR(32), 
	agent_version_id CHAR(32), 
	run_id CHAR(32), 
	session_id CHAR(32), 
	context_manifest_id CHAR(32), 
	external_agent_id CHAR(32), 
	external_credential_id CHAR(32), 
	external_run_id CHAR(32), 
	ownership_scope_id CHAR(32), 
	project_id CHAR(32), 
	operation VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	proposal_change_id CHAR(32), 
	decided_by_user_id CHAR(32), 
	source_event_cursors JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_contribution_stable_actor FOREIGN KEY(external_credential_id, external_agent_id, sponsor_user_id) REFERENCES external_agent_credentials (id, agent_id, sponsor_user_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_contribution_run_binding FOREIGN KEY(run_id, session_id, project_id, sponsor_user_id, agent_version_id) REFERENCES agent_runs (id, session_id, project_id, requested_by_user_id, agent_version_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_contribution_manifest_binding FOREIGN KEY(context_manifest_id, run_id, project_id, sponsor_user_id, agent_version_id) REFERENCES context_manifests (id, run_id, project_id, requested_by_user_id, agent_version_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_contribution_external_run_binding FOREIGN KEY(external_run_id, external_credential_id, project_id, sponsor_user_id) REFERENCES external_research_runs (id, credential_id, project_id, sponsor_user_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_contribution_review CHECK ((proposal_change_id IS NULL AND decided_by_user_id IS NULL) OR (actor_kind = 'AGENT' AND proposal_change_id IS NOT NULL AND decided_by_user_id IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_contribution_envelopes_actor_kind CHECK (actor_kind IN ('HUMAN', 'AGENT')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_contribution_envelopes_actor_scope CHECK (((actor_kind = 'HUMAN' AND human_user_id IS NOT NULL AND sponsor_user_id IS NULL AND agent_version_id IS NULL AND run_id IS NULL AND session_id IS NULL AND context_manifest_id IS NULL AND external_credential_id IS NULL AND external_run_id IS NULL AND external_agent_id IS NULL) OR (actor_kind = 'AGENT' AND human_user_id IS NULL AND sponsor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND agent_version_id IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND context_manifest_id IS NOT NULL AND project_id IS NOT NULL AND external_credential_id IS NULL AND external_run_id IS NULL AND external_agent_id IS NULL) OR (actor_kind = 'AGENT' AND human_user_id IS NULL AND sponsor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND agent_version_id IS NULL AND run_id IS NULL AND session_id IS NULL AND context_manifest_id IS NULL AND project_id IS NOT NULL AND external_credential_id IS NOT NULL AND external_run_id IS NOT NULL) OR (actor_kind = 'AGENT' AND human_user_id IS NULL AND sponsor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND agent_version_id IS NULL AND run_id IS NULL AND session_id IS NULL AND context_manifest_id IS NULL AND external_run_id IS NULL AND external_agent_id IS NOT NULL AND external_credential_id IS NOT NULL))), 
	FOREIGN KEY(human_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sponsor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(agent_version_id) REFERENCES platform_agent_versions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES agent_runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(context_manifest_id) REFERENCES context_manifests (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(external_agent_id) REFERENCES external_agent_identities (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(external_credential_id) REFERENCES external_agent_credentials (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(external_run_id) REFERENCES external_research_runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(ownership_scope_id) REFERENCES research_scopes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(proposal_change_id) REFERENCES proposal_changes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(decided_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE correction_decisions (

	action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	decided_by_user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE correction_suggestions (
	revision_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_revision_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	proposed JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (revision_id),
